notes: 5.0.4: Movies and series have a "Sound & subtitles" button: choose the subtitle language (or none) and the sound language the film offers. Faznet remembers your choice for the next film or episode.
notes_en: 5.0.4: Movies and series have a "Sound & subtitles" button: choose the subtitle language (or none) and the sound language the film offers. Faznet remembers your choice for the next film or episode.
notes_sq: 5.0.4: Filmat dhe serialet kanë butonin "Zëri dhe titrat": zgjidh gjuhën e titrave (ose pa titra) dhe gjuhën e zërit që ka filmi. Faznet e mban mend zgjedhjen për filmin ose episodin tjetër.
